newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys one 2H July reformate cargo at $24.70.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys one 2H July reformate cargo at $24.70.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought through tender one July 16-30 cargo of unleaded 95-octane reformate at around $24.70 per barrel cost-and-freight (c+f), a company official said on Thursday.
"We needed to take only one cargo," the official said, denying market rumours of a purchase of two cargoes.
The tender which sought 250,00-barrels to the ports of Keelung or Taichung between July 16-30, closed June 4 and is valid for two days.
The award is lower than CPC's last award of two cargoes of unleaded reformate at $25.20 per barrel c+f for June 21-30 arrival and $24.92 for July 1-15 delivery.
